criteria_results.text: The current development app launches in an iOS simulator with exactly three primary tabs and remains usable in light, dark, and large-text states.
criteria_results.notes: The branch-built development scheme loaded its local Metro bundle and rendered Agents, Tools, and Settings. Light/default and dark/accessibility-large states were navigable without clipped critical actions.

criteria_results.text: The shipping mobile client and restricted desktop gateway advertise the same generated agent-protocol contract fingerprint so authenticated pairing can proceed.
criteria_results.notes: Package-local contract checks passed, but authenticated physical-device preflight reported incompatible agent protocols. Source comparison shows the mobile shipping pin differs from the gateway compatibility fingerprint; no existing test asserts equality across the package boundary.

process_issues.description: The first XcodeBuildMCP run omitted NODE_ENV and EXPO_APP_VARIANT from Xcode build phases, causing the development native scheme to evaluate the guarded Expo config as production.
process_issues.detected_by: Xcode build log and direct development-config evaluation. Passing both values as explicit xcodebuild settings produced a successful build and launch without a source change.

failure_output: Authenticated pairing preflight: this Mac and app use incompatible agent protocols.
suggested_follow_up: Add a cross-package failing contract test that compares the generated shipping fingerprint with the gateway compatibility constant, update the stale gateway/classification artifacts from the canonical generated contract, and re-run pairing compatibility plus the simulator and live-sandbox gates.
